# MINE!!! — Minecraft Illustrated Encyclopedia

Java 1.21.4. The MINE!!! adventure uses custom recipes; this guide documents Minecraft registry facts. Unknown fields are labeled.

## 01. How blocks work

Start with the world beneath your feet.

Hardness measures breaking time; blast resistance measures resistance to explosions. They are different properties.

A placed block is not always obtainable as an inventory item. Air, fluids and technical states appear in the registry too.

Survival emphasizes gathering and progression; Creative provides building materials and flight. Adventure restricts interaction through map rules. Spectator is for observing the world. This field guide is distinct from the custom MINE!!! adventure rules.


## 02. Natural ground

The foundation of every adventure.

Learn the difference between a block that can be broken and a block that drops itself.

Use the researched entries for collection exceptions; unknown details remain explicitly unverified.

### Sand

## 03. Stone & deepslate

From your first shelter to a mountain fortress.

Compare hardness and blast resistance before choosing a building material.

A preferred tool does not guarantee the correct harvest tier. Check the allowed tools in each entry.

## 19. Master index & glossary

A place for every block, and a path back.

Hardness: resistance to breaking. Blast resistance: resistance to explosions.

Renewable: obtainable repeatedly without exhausting finite world generation; unknown here unless explicitly researched.
